description: A slot-machine style picker with 1-3 columns. Each column defaults to its title and writes selected display values back to data model when scrolling settles.

columns.description: Column data. Supports 1 to 3 columns at runtime; extra columns are ignored.

title.description: Column title shown in default state.

selection.description: Display values of each column, one entry per rendered column. Default value of a column is its title.

path.description: A relative or absolute path in the data model.

hasCustomSelection.description: Optional boolean reference. True when at least one column is not on default title.

path.description: A relative or absolute path in the data model.

title: RollPicker
